basic_info.description: Price Reduced....Seller says sell! Charming 2+ bedroom Victorian Cottage. Remodeled, polished and shined and ready for you and yours. Bonus attic room, great for your extra needs....kids,office, guests, storage, yoga! Spacious garage with tons of storage, or if you like to setup a workroom you have the space here. The back yard is private and great for BBQ's, reading a book with a drink while sunbathing. Really sweet light filled home. Attic room unwarranted by seller or agent. Price reduced and now it is a short sale....only one lender! Bring an offer!
